input.quote: ARTICLE XII INDEMNITY Licensee will be solely responsible for any commercial or legal liability that may arise as a result of Licensee's exercise of any of the license rights granted by Licensor to Licensee under this Agreement, and Licensee shall defend, indemnify, and hold Licensor harmless from and against any and all suits, claims, proceedings, judgments, awards, damages, loss, liability, cost and expenses
input.rationale: Indemnity in this Agreement runs one way only: Article XII (p0128-p0129) is a broad Licensee indemnity in favour of Licensor, and there is no Licensor indemnity anywhere (no responsive language in Articles VIII, X, XIII or the General Provisions). Article XIII(a) compounds this by providing that "UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE ... THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY ... MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT", and Article XIII(b) caps Licensor's total liability at one half of amounts paid. That is walk-away territory (no Vendor IP indemnity plus a one-way Customer indemnity), so it fails the fallback. We therefore target the fallback: a Licensor IP indemnity with the customary Customer modification, combination and specification exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, subject to a 3x annual fees super-cap, and we carve that indemnity out of Article XIII(a) and (b) only so far as necessary to keep it effective. We have not sought the preferred-level additions (defence duty, affiliates, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, procedure, narrowing of Licensee's indemnity) in this redline.

mappings.element: Vendor indemnifies Customer against third-party intellectual-property claims.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer modifications.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer combinations.
The IP indemnity may exclude infringement caused by Customer specifications.
Vendor must procure continued use, modify, or replace the infringing item.
Vendor must refund applicable fees if procure, modify, or replace remedies are unavailable.
Vendor's indemnity is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.

proposal.summary: Insert Licensor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, remedies and 3x annual fees super-cap, and conform Article XIII so it does not negate the indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains only a Licensee indemnity running to Licensor, and Article XIII expressly bars any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we add a Licensor IP indemnity with the usual modification, combination and specification exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees. We carve that indemnity out of Article XIII(a) and (b) only as needed to make it effective; this is our fallback position.

ops.text: ARTICLE XII-A LICENSOR IP INDEMNITY Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against any third-party claim alleging that the Licensed Technology infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right, excluding any claim arising from (i) modifications to the Licensed Technology made by Licensee, (ii) combination of the Licensed Technology with items not supplied by Licensor, or (iii) Licensee's specifications. Licensor shall procure for Licensee the right to continue using, or shall modify or replace, the affected Licensed Technology, and if none of those remedies is available, Licensor shall refund the fees paid by Licensee for the affected Licensed Technology. Licensor's aggregate liability under this Article XII-A shall not exceed three times the annual fees paid by Licensee under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: OR OTHERWISE UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE BY LICENSEE OR ANY THIRD PARTY THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED, RESULTS OR MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT, DEPRIVATION OR VIOLATION OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CONSTITUTIONAL, STATUTORY, CONTRACTUAL, COMMON LAW OR OTHER RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY
